# camunda_cluster_restore (Action)

Restore a backup onto its cluster and wait until the restore has completed. **The cluster's current data is replaced by the backup**, and the cluster is suspended until the restore is in flight. Fails if the backup can't be restored, for example while another restore is running. Needs Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "camunda_cluster_backups" "all" {
  cluster_id = camunda_cluster.test.id
}

action "camunda_cluster_restore" "example" {
  config {
    cluster_id = camunda_cluster.test.id
    backup_id  = data.camunda_cluster_backups.all.backups[0].id
  }
}

# Run it with:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.camunda_cluster_restore.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_id` (String) ID of the backup to restore, see `camunda_cluster_backup` and `camunda_cluster_backups`.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID
